comment: Read receipt disclosure policy and per-scope client preference vectors. Spec: discovery/read-receipts.md §2.4-§2.5 and discovery/client-preferences.md §3.6. Disclosure policy is a soft (non-cryptographic) commitment carried by the component cell ck.component.realm.read_receipt_policy.v1 (cas-register, bottom=reject). Per spec 2026-05-08, track-level read-receipt overrides (cx.flow.track.read_receipt_policy) were removed; when a discussion timeline needs a read-receipt policy distinct from its parent Space it MUST be upgraded to an independent child Space (Flow.scope_circle_id pointing at a Circle, per CKP-0007) whose own ck.realm.read_receipt_policy declares the override. User preferences live under the actor-private account-data key ck.read_receipt.preferences. The decision rule is: required > disabled > optional defers to (child_space → space → default).

vectors.name: disclosure_required_locks_client_send
vectors.comment: When a Space declares disclosure=required, even a user preference of send=false MUST be overridden — compliant clients send the receipt and lock the UI toggle.

vectors.name: disclosure_disabled_drops_receipt_at_sync_service
vectors.comment: When a Space declares disclosure=disabled, even a user preference of send=true MUST be overridden — compliant clients MUST NOT generate the receipt and Sync Service MUST drop any inbound ck.receipt.read for this scope.

vectors.name: visibility_private_fanout_only_to_sender
vectors.comment: When visibility=private, Sync Service MUST only fanout the receipt to the original sender of the referenced event_id. Other Space members MUST NOT observe it.

vectors.name: branch_overrides_tighten_only
vectors.comment: A child Space (upgraded discussion timeline, Flow.scope_circle_id binding) MAY tighten the parent Space's read-receipt policy without scope_overrides_allowed=true. Optional → Required at the child Space is a tightening (forces send), Members → Private is also a tightening (smaller audience). Note: track-level overrides are removed in v1 (see removed-event-kinds.json: cx.flow.track.read_receipt_policy) — the child-Space surface is the only legitimate scope for a per-discussion override.

vectors.name: branch_overrides_loosen_rejected_when_not_allowed
vectors.comment: When the parent Space declares scope_overrides_allowed=false, a child Space MUST NOT loosen the policy (Required→Optional, Private→Public, etc.). Composition keeps the parent value for the loosened field. Reducer SHOULD reject the loosening Move with bottom=reject. Track-level override is not available (removed in v1) — the child-Space ck.realm.read_receipt_policy is the only surface.

vectors.name: prefs_resolution_flow_overrides_space
vectors.comment: When policy is optional and the user has both parent-Space-level and child-Space-level (Flow.scope_circle_id, CKP-0007) overrides, the child-Space override wins. Resolution order is child_space → space → default (track-level overrides are not in v1; see removed-event-kinds.json).

vectors.name: prefs_resolution_space_overrides_default
vectors.comment: Without a child-Space-level override, the parent-Space-level override wins over the default.
